description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different types of videos in a dataset. There are 15 categories of videos shown. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any slices that are visually emphasized. The segments are ordered by size, with People Blogs being the largest category and Music being the smallest.
